Offsetting: peer template for this exact calendar quarter was an order miss (aggregate +1% vs +4% est), backlog units down 11% YoY while community count grew 9%, adjusted margin stepping 26.5% to 26.2% to a guided 25.25%, sell side stacked bullish at a $168.20 average target with room to cut, and six of the last eight reactions were negative. Conviction low.
